# OWASP channel monitor

Shared files in this folder: `reviewer-contract.md`, `categories/`, `scripts/Get-OwaspCategories.ps1`.
For every new pull request posted in the channel, run the `owasp-pr-review:teams-owasp-pr-review` skill.
